status: descriptive effect-size definitions frozen before outputs were opened
purpose: Translate calibrated vertical-identity log scores into interpretable magnitudes without changing any inferential endpoint.

observed_likelihood_multiplier.interpretation: Geometric-mean per-fix likelihood ratio of the same-individual vertical profile relative to the other-individual profile under identical horizontal cell weights.
observed_likelihood_multiplier.caveat: A value below 1 is possible even when the estimator-calibrated signal exceeds exchangeability expectation.

calibrated_likelihood_multiplier.definition: exp(observed common-cell marginal identity - panel-specific permutation-null mean)
calibrated_likelihood_multiplier.interpretation: Multiplicative scale of the log-score excess above the finite-sample exchangeability expectation.
calibrated_likelihood_multiplier.caveat: This is a calibrated effect scale, not a literal probability ratio between two biological generative models.

entropy_equivalent_fraction.definition: (observed common-cell marginal identity - panel-specific permutation-null mean) / equal-individual mean empirical Shannon entropy of target vertical bins on exactly the scored fixes
entropy_equivalent_fraction.interpretation: Size of calibrated identity information relative to the target session's vertical-state uncertainty.
entropy_equivalent_fraction.caveat: Not mutual information, not variance explained, and not constrained to 0–1.

pairwise_self_identification.definition: For each held-out target session and each alternative individual in the same cohort, integrate the self and alternative P(z|cell) under the same equal-session self cell-use weights on common supported cells; score the target z values; a self win is gain >0. Aggregate alternative comparisons within target session, sessions within individual, then individuals equally.
pairwise_self_identification.interpretation: How often the same bat's vertical profile outpredicts a specific other bat after horizontal weighting is held common.

focal_agl_height_separation_m.definition: For each held-out target session, estimate each training session's mean AGL within supported 5-km cells. Average cell means equally across self sessions and equally across other individuals, then integrate both using the same self cell-use weights. Record absolute difference between the self and other expected AGL. Aggregate sessions within individual then individuals equally.
focal_agl_height_separation_m.caveat: Captures mean-height separation only; distribution-shape differences can exist even when this value is small.

stop_rule: Do not add or remove effect-size metrics after any output is opened.
Do not select only panels with large translated effects.
Do not interpret calibrated likelihood multipliers as raw biological odds.
Do not compare meter-scale height separation across MSL and ellipsoid panels; meter translation is focal AGL only.
